integrity: One uniform mathematical claim across the proof and comparison artifacts. Exact symbolic identities and finite matrix calculations supplement an analytical proof. No independent mathematical audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact for n>=3 and uniform positive pendant conductance with exactly two noise-free leaders only; not for nonuniform edge weights, other leader budgets, or finite-gain leaders. Earliest focal research framework was publicly available in 2013; this date is not an assertion that the new finding was published then.
title: Exact two-leader phase transition on weighted sunlet graphs
